EC-002.note: Native file opening validates through EditorSource before creating a window and normalizes orientation. Recent-file selection and complete color metadata handling remain pending.

EC-003.note: The optional URL-opening feature is not offered.

EC-005.note: EditorViewport holds zoom and pan outside document history. Native actions, Control+wheel, pinch, scrollbars, middle drag, Space+drag, and keyboard pan share that state. EditorViewportTest and EditorCanvasTest verify immutable pixels and geometry, clean checkpoints, and unchanged history.

EC-006.note: Finite zoom is bounded to 1/64..64. Zoom keeps the logical point under the pointer unless image visibility bounds require clamping; native scrollbars and pan keep at least a 32px strip accessible. The status bar exposes zoom. Native tests cover wheel/pinch anchoring, finite bounds, zoom-independent hit targets and rotated previews.

EC-017.note: Viewport inputs reject non-finite values and enforce bounded scales without changing the session. The full apply-operations adapter and pixel/canvas operations remain pending; only viewport-only currently passes, so this capability is not in the qualified conformance suite.
